subject.title: fix: prevent cron and Workboard lifecycle races

question: Should maintainers accept the changed cron failure-route inheritance semantics—clearing inherited target and account when a job changes channel or delivery mode—after reviewing the full delivery contract and final exact-head checks?
rationale: This PR intentionally changes compatibility-sensitive message routing behavior; the supplied patch and tests support the direction, but the protected maintainer label and unavailable local inspection prevent an automated final approval.

options.title: Confirm and merge after checks
options.body: Accept the scoped routing contract if full current-code review and required exact-head checks confirm that channel and account ownership remain consistent.

options.title: Request a narrower routing proof
options.body: Keep the PR open and ask for a maintainer-reviewed matrix covering existing global, job-specific, channel-last, and webhook upgrade configurations.

recommendation.title: Confirm and merge after checks
recommendation.body: Accept the scoped routing contract if full current-code review and required exact-head checks confirm that channel and account ownership remain consistent.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context ties this contributor to the proposed cron and Workboard lifecycle ownership changes; repository-history ownership could not be verified locally.
